name: letter-spacing
note: Letter-spaced runs: the engine measures the base advance with the Canvas interface's measureText and adds letterSpacing × codepoint count (Blink semantics — spacing applies after the trailing character too), while the Chrome oracle sets ctx.letterSpacing. Covers positive, fractional, and negative spacing on Latin, CJK, and kerning-heavy pairs. Letter-spacing on Arabic is a known gap: Chrome does not apply letter-spacing to joining scripts.
